articles.summary: Depot built an S3-backed Ubuntu mirror and tuned apt and dpkg to cut median package installation time from 19 seconds to 3 seconds. Common setup work now takes less time.
articles.title: We built an Ubuntu mirror and then made it faster

articles.summary: Depot Metal builds runtime estimates from job fingerprints and history. They helped cut p99 host drain time from just over three hours to about one hour.
articles.title: How job fingerprints help us scale down faster
